choice_data_list: If you want, you can have all of this!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, for me!? Are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only played the crane game because I 
wanted to give the prizes to the students 
at the ballet studio. I decided to tell 
her the truth.
choice_data_list: I hope more kids will come to love ballet.

It'd be nice if more kids came to love 
ballet, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! Hehe... I'm so 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The younger students, and Mom and Dad too, 
will totally be thrilled, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'll tell everyone too! That my Trainer, 
who always takes such good care of me, won 
it for me...!"
